sentences.text:
This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimants being aggrieved of the award dated 20.12.2018 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal (M.P.) in MCC No.690/2014, whereby claim petition filed by the claimants,
is dismissed on account of the fact that accident of the deceased could not be proved with the vehicle owned by the respondent No.2.
2. Shri Kapil Patwardhan, learned counsel for the claimants submits that Ex.D-4 is the final report.
He submits that claim should have been allowed and on hyper technicalities it should not have been dismissed.

3. Shri Rohit Jain, learned counsel for the respondent No.3- Insurance Company submits that neither the final report, which is against the claimants, was challenged by filing an appropriate application nor Investigating officer was called to substantiate that accident had actually taken place and there are lacuna in the final report.
In absence of accident being proved, learned Tribunal has rightly dismissed the claim.

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I do not find any illegality in the impugned award as factum of accident is not proved, which is sine qua non for grant of compensation.
5. In view of above, appeal fails and is dismissed.
6. Record of the Claims Tribunal be sent back.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Paras Ram @ Asharam Kushwah vs Amit Mourya on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10928726/
